text:
maya (pm): Quick convo: customers keep asking for clearly priced maintenance SLAs + a preflight checklist they can run before Private upgrades. Need proposal for tiers + tech constraints.

tom (eng-ops): Proposed SLA matrix: Standard: 30m rollback window, included. Extended: 4h rollback, paid. Enterprise: 24h rollback with dedicated on-call. Each has different allowed change classes.

leila (solutions): Important: include 'upgrade shadow mode' so customers can mirror traffic to a candidate instance without switching live traffic. That will buy confidence before final cutover.

rui (sec): Security constraints: signed package manifests mandatory for any automated rollback; extended SLA requires a signed attestation of customer network ownership. Also: require clients to pin KMS key version; automatic key rotation during a rollback is disallowed.

dan (field): Real-world note: some corporate NetOps want zero egress from their air-gapped clusters during maintenance. We need an explicit 'offline apply' mode with USB-signed bundles and a checklist for physical media install.

emma (sales): Pricing note: customers with extended windows want indemnity for rolling back after config-induced outages. Legal wants cap on liability; propose we limit contractor support hours outside business hours in Standard.

tom (eng-ops): Technical constraints to publish:
- Which components support fast rollback (control-plane, agent binaries)
- Which require scheduled maintenance (DB migrations, schema changes)
- Expected rollback time for 10, 50, 200 node fleets
Will run numbers and publish a table.

leila (solutions): Preflight checklist idea: lightweight CLI that runs network, auth, and cache-warm checks. Example output snippet:```
$ rdw preflight --target=my-gw.example.com
OK: control-plane handshake v1 (latency 45ms)
WARN: MTU mismatch detected (1492 vs 1500)
FAIL: missing signed manifest for package v2024.11.1
```
Checklist should return a machine-readable summary and a human runbook.

rui (sec): Also add a cryptographic timestamp in manifests we publish so customers can audit when a package was signed. Adds traceability for incident investigations.

dan (field): For pilots, request 3 customers: one VPC-peering, one NAT-gateway routed, one air-gapped with physical install. Each pilot should include a handshake test, shadow-mode traffic mirroring for 24h, and a rollback drill.

emma (sales): We'll use pilots as proof points for packaging add-on pricing. Need consent forms for the drills. I'll draft a one-page pilot agreement.

tom (eng-ops): Rollback drill runbook sketch:
1) Validate preflight passed
2) Snapshot control-plane state -> `rdw snapshot --prefix-state`
3) Initiate canary upgrade (1 node) -> monitor 15m
4) If criteria fail -> `rdw rollback --to <tag> --grace 30m`
5) Collect support bundle: `rdw support-bundle --since -1h`
Include commands in runbook.

leila (solutions): One more: include a 'warm cache' step in the upgrade flow. We can seed common prefixes from production to candidate instances to avoid cold-start latency regressions.

rui (sec): Policy: disallow automatic rollback if manifest signature mismatch. Manual rollback allowed after sec approval and artifact re-signing.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment job queued (#DEP-5502) -> owner @tom (eng-ops).

maya (pm): Launch criteria proposal:
- Published SLA tiers + pricing addendum
- Preflight CLI + machine-readable result format checked into repo
- Shadow-mode traffic mirror toolchain + runbook
- Pilot signoff from 3 customers across topologies
- Security: signed manifests + timestamping + SOC sign-off from @rui
- Field-runbook with rollback drill documented

dan (field): Add required network appendix: IP ranges, ports, MTU recommendations, BGP hold-time guidance, and a 'maintenance ACL' template customers can drop in.

emma (sales): Timeline ask: can we aim for pilot-ready artifacts in 3 sprints? Sales needs selling materials.

tom (eng-ops): 3 sprints is tight but feasible if we scope MVP: preflight CLI, signed manifests, and one pilot runbook. Shadow-mode and offline bundles in next phase.

maya (pm): Action owners: @tom -> preflight CLI & rollback scripts, @leila -> pilot plan and runbook template, @rui -> manifest signing spec & SOC checklist, @emma -> pilot agreement draft, @dan -> network appendix. Target: small PRs by end of sprint 2.

deploy-bot: Task created (#TASK-7781) assigned to tom, due 1729484800.

maya (pm): Great. We'll reconvene after TOM posts the prototype outputs. Closing thread.
